summary: nitro-cjs-requirer posts installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: The package declares a postinstall hook that runs beacon.cjs, which collects the installer's hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node version and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The same beacon fires again at require-time: index.js immediately invokes beacon.cjs and then exports a Proxy of no-op functions so that any consumer import resolves without error. The package ships no real functionality beyond this install- and load-time callback. The destination is unrelated to any legitimate publisher infrastructure and a self-describing 'build-provenance beacon' comment does not reflect consent from the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
